Root facing right throughout, preserve face shape and accessories. Creature-appropriate movement: soft tiny steps for light creature/tree, padded fox/dragon steps, mechanical robot, waddling penguin/owl.
Frames24-27: STOP WALKING, from contact posture to weight settling and stable RIGHT-facing stand with both feet grounded.27 is a comfortable SIDE STANDING idle pose.
Frames28-31: TURN IN from that RIGHT-facing stand through three-quarter back to EXACT approved resting view, gradual head+body turn,31 matching0. This is ONE complete motion with 5 phases.
